title: Calculate an issuer-default knockout option value
outcome: Calculate an issuer-default knockout bond option value on a supplied joint rate-credit lattice by applying survival to option continuation and zero option payoff on pre-expiry default.
misconceptions: The option continuation value should include the bond's recovery cash flow in the default branch.
Unconditional survival to expiry can always replace node-by-node conditional survival in a state-dependent lattice.
